title: World Strike: a sandbox on real city maps
excerpt: Drive a toy tank through any real city with other players and knock over blocky buildings.
content_html:
THE WORLD IS YOUR SANDBOX.

  • Drive a toy tank through any real city.
  • Knock over blocky buildings. They stay down for everyone.
  • Duel other tanks and spray your mark on the rubble.

A toy world built on OpenStreetMap.

WASD drive · Mouse aim · Click fire

Tap the street to aim, hold FIRE to shoot.
